name: Cindervane
title: The Young Embermaw
biography: A two-headed juvenile hydra patrols the volcanic riverbanks beneath Kaedros’s watch. It overcommits both necks when breathing fire.
weakness: Its throat scales open after either attack; ordinary armored hits deal less damage.

skills.name: Forked Embers
skills.description: Two heads breathe across a locked sector. Dodge behind the necks or leave the marked edge.

skills.name: Cinder Ring
skills.description: An ember ring blooms around the hydra. The clear center and space outside the ring stay safe.

review.combat: Implemented using shared family controller; complete individual fight not replayed.
review.phase: Distinct form observed via explicitly labelled phase rehearsal; natural threshold crossing not reviewed.
